in_hebrew.name: Mart
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shortened form of Mars
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mart הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Roman god Mars, meaning 'god of war'. In Christianity, Mart may represent courage and strength.

in_greek.name: Mart

in_latin.name: Mars
in_latin.long_meaning: The Roman god of agriculture and the guardian of Rome, identified with Ares in Greek mythology.
